PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: Public non-PII workshop member display profile for Jay's Job Club.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

username.description: Public display username shown on Ground Floor Job & Collab Board posts, Show & Tell tools, Service Provider cards, and Artisan Shop listings.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

CommunityPost.title: CommunityPost
CommunityPost.description: A message posted to the Ground Floor Job & Collab Board.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the poster, referencing PublicProfile.

message.description: Detailed body content of the post.

visibility.description: Lifecycle state of the post (archived is terminal).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the post was last updated.

CanopyStudio.title: CanopyStudio
CanopyStudio.description: Per-player customizable Personal Trade Area, Secure Flooring, and placed Canopy Lanterns/Furnishings in the Canopy Summit.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the studio owner.

studioName.description: Custom nameplate title for the player's Canopy Personal Trade Area.

tradeFocus.description: Special interest or trade specialty showcased in the Canopy booth.

floorStyle.description: Selected secure non-slip flooring surface in the Canopy Treehouse.

trimAccent.description: Selected safety toe-kick curb and hatch guard accent finish.

safetyGateClosed.description: Whether the Lift arrival bay safety hatch gate is latched closed for a continuous floor.

furnishedItems.description: Bounded allowlist (max 6) of active Canopy lanterns and furnishings displayed inside the 3D Treehouse.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the studio configuration was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the studio configuration was last updated.

JournalEntry.title: JournalEntry
JournalEntry.description: Private chronological Personal Journal entry for capturing special interest ideas, working papers, job steps, and neuro-affirming pacing notes.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the private journal entry owner.

content.description: Body notes, special interest papers, or reflection content.

entryType.description: Focus tag connecting the journal note to special interests, papers, job steps, or collab/trade.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the journal entry was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the journal entry was last edited.

TreeProgress.title: TreeProgress
TreeProgress.description: Per-player Welcome Area check-in, Trying/Gathering/Treehouse Tokens, owned Canopy furnishings, and Daily Mastery Streak.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

tryingTokens.description: Lower-level Trying Tokens earned for posting on the job board, checking in at the Welcome Area, and practicing skills.

gatheringTokens.description: Second-level Gathering Tokens earned for gathering special interest items, ideas, or papers along the tree and journal.

treehouseTokens.description: Treehouse Tokens awarded for sound, humane, and ethical trade/outreach ideas and streak milestones.

ownedFurnishings.description: Bounded allowlist (max 6) of Canopy lantern and furnishing kinds owned by the member.

sharesCompleted.description: Count of Collab, Trade Building, Job Steps, or Trade Sharing exchanges completed.

welcomeCheckedIn.description: Whether the player has completed the Welcome Area orientation check-in.

dailyStreak.description: Current consecutive daily mastery streak for accessing the Canopy or updating the Journal (with 1-day grace buffer).

bestStreak.description: Highest consecutive daily mastery streak achieved by the member.

lastStreakDate.description: Local YYYY-MM-DD calendar date of the most recent recorded Canopy or Journal mastery engagement.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when tree progress was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when tree progress was last updated.

ToolOfTrade.title: ToolOfTrade
ToolOfTrade.description: A stored Tool of the Trade kept in a member's Canopy Show & Tell Locker and optionally shared with fellow members.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member storing the tool.

toolName.description: Name of the Tool of the Trade.

tradeCategory.description: Trade or outreach discipline associated with this tool.

visualKind.description: 3D model identifier displayed on the Canopy Show & Tell pegboard and Tools of the Trade locker.

showAndTellStory.description: Ethical, constructive explanation of how this tool is used for craft, repair, or community outreach.

isSharedShowAndTell.description: Whether this tool is displayed in the Club Show & Tell Gallery for fellow members.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the tool was stowed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the tool entry was last updated.

StoreListing.title: StoreListing
StoreListing.description: Player-crafted Canopy lantern or furnishing listed in the Player Store for purchase with Treehouse Tokens.

sellerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member offering the crafted item.

title.description: Custom listing title for the crafted Canopy item.

craftNote.description: Maker note describing the craftsmanship and materials.

status.description: Marketplace lifecycle state (cancelled is terminal; sold locks once proceedsClaimed is true).

buyerId.description: Empty string while available/cancelled, or Firebase Auth UID of the purchasing player once sold.

proceedsClaimed.description: Whether the seller has claimed the Treehouse Token proceeds after sale.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when listed.

ServiceProvider.title: ServiceProvider
ServiceProvider.description: Autism-affirming & neurobiologically-aware service provider listing (Pre-Crisis Intervention Counsellor, Crisis Coaching Specialist, or Neurobiologically-Aware Skills & Trade Trainer).

providerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registered practitioner or trade trainer.

displayName.description: Public non-PII practitioner or mentor handle.

specialtySummary.description: Concrete summary of skills taught, pre-crisis de-escalation support, or trade mentoring approach.

neuroAccommodations.description: Explicit sensory, pacing, and communication accommodations honored in sessions.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when registered.

ArtisanItem.title: ArtisanItem
ArtisanItem.description: Physical handcrafted item listed in the Ground Floor Welcome Area Artisan Market for purchase via PayPal.

makerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the artisan craftsperson.

makerName.description: Public display name of the maker.

materialsAndDimensions.description: Tactile materials, natural finishes, and physical dimensions.

priceCents.description: Price in GBP pence / minor units (integer 300..250000, i.e., £3.00 to £2,500.00).

status.description: Shop listing lifecycle state (archived is terminal).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when listed.

PrivacyConsent.title: PrivacyConsent
PrivacyConsent.description: Owner-only UK/EU GDPR Article 7(1) demonstrable granular consent record containing zero PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the consenting member.

policyVersion.description: Version identifier of the UK/EU GDPR Privacy Notice acknowledged by the user.

localDeviceStorage.description: Whether the user consented to non-essential local browser storage caching (PECR Reg. 6).

cloudProgressSync.description: Whether the user consented to syncing Canopy Studio, tokens, and Daily Streak to Firestore (Art. 6(1)(a)).

privateJournalCloudSync.description: Whether the user explicitly consented to encrypted-in-transit private Personal Journal cloud backup (Art. 6(1)(a) & Art. 9(2)(a)).

communityAttributionConsent.description: Whether the user consented to publishing their chosen handle on community boards, tools, providers, or shop listings (Art. 6(1)(a)).

liveCollabPresenceConsent.description: Whether the user consented to real-time WebSocket collaboration room & 3D lift presence (Art. 6(1)(a)).

usePseudonym.description: Privacy-by-default flag keeping real Google account names hidden behind a workshop alias (Art. 25).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when consent record was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when consent choices were last updated or withdrawn.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted workshop administrator record for approving Treetop Token entry applications and moderating Canopy workshops (zero PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

handle.description: Non-PII display handle of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when admin role was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin record was last updated.

TreetopApplication.title: TreetopApplication
TreetopApplication.description: Ground Sign-In Kiosk entry application sharing a visitor's Special Interest Journey to request an Admin-approved Treetop Token required for entering Jay's Job Club.

applicantId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the applicant.

displayName.description: Non-PII workshop alias chosen by the applicant.

specialInterestJourney.description: Applicant's response to 'We like to hear about your special interest journeys' describing their passion and trade/outreach goals.

preferredTradeTrack.description: Primary special-interest trade track the applicant hopes to explore.

supervisionContext.description: Safeguarding context confirming whether the applicant is a competent adult (18+) or supported by a parent, carer, or competent adult.

status.description: Admin review status for Treetop Token entry.

treetopTokenGranted.description: True only when approved by an Admin; strictly required before entering the Treehouse or Canopy.

tokenCode.description: Empty string until approved, or Admin-issued Treetop Token code matching ^TTK-[A-Z0-9\-]+$.

adminNote.description: Optional constructive feedback or welcome note written by the reviewing Admin.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the application was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the application or token status was last updated.

PgCertNote.title: PgCertNote
PgCertNote.description: Reflective academic and neuro-affirming practice study notes from a PG Cert Autism and Mental Health student in training.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the PG Cert student-in-training author.

studentHandle.description: Non-PII academic study handle (e.g., PG Cert Student in Training).

moduleTheme.description: Postgraduate Autism & Mental Health curriculum domain.

title.description: Headline of the PG Cert study note.

studyReflection.description: Reflective PG Cert Autism & Mental Health study notes and literature synthesis.

practiceTakeaway.description: Concrete workshop accommodation or low-arousal practice takeaway.

visibility.description: Publication status (archived is terminal for non-admin updates).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when published.

CanopyWorkshop.title: CanopyWorkshop
CanopyWorkshop.description: Scheduled 33m Treetop Canopy special-interest training or learn-a-trade workshop rota slot with optional safeguarded social/video overflow.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workshop host.

hostName.description: Non-PII display handle of the trade mentor or facilitator.

title.description: Workshop title on the Treetop Canopy Rota.

specialInterestFocus.description: Description of how a special interest connects to practical trade skills in this workshop.

rotaSlotLabel.description: Day and UK time window on the Canopy Rota.

sensoryPacingNote.description: Explicit sensory, communication, and pacing accommodations.

overflowPlatform.description: External meet-up channel if the Canopy workshop overflows onto video or social platforms.

overflowSummary.description: Safeguarding summary describing what the optional overflow meet-up covers without exposing raw external links.

status.description: Rota lifecycle status (completed and cancelled are terminal for non-admin updates).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when scheduled.

WorkshopRegistration.title: WorkshopRegistration
WorkshopRegistration.description: Member booking for a 33m Canopy Rota workshop including mandatory parent/carer or competent adult approval before accessing external Zoom/Facebook/Social Media overflow.

attendeeId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the Treetop Token holder.

attendeeName.description: Non-PII workshop handle of the attendee.

wantsSocialOverflow.description: Whether the attendee requests access to the external Zoom/Facebook/Social Media overflow meet-up.

adultApprovalType.description: Type of parent, carer, or competent adult approval recorded for external overflow.

adultApprovalConfirmed.description: Must be true whenever wantsSocialOverflow is true.

appropriatenessConfirmed.description: Confirms topic appropriateness and moderated safeguarding conduct rules.

safeguardingNote.description: Optional non-PII safeguarding or pacing note for the session.

status.description: Registration status (cancelled is terminal for non-admin updates).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when registered.

WorkshopOverflowDetail.title: WorkshopOverflowDetail
WorkshopOverflowDetail.description: Protected subcollection document storing external Zoom/Facebook/Social Media overflow instructions, readable only after Treetop Token + Parent/Carer/Competent Adult approval.

hostId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workshop host.

platformLabel.description: External platform label matching the workshop overflow platform.

joinInstructionsAndHandle.description: Moderated room code, group name, or supervised join instructions unlocked after adult approval.

moderationRules.description: Safeguarding boundaries (e.g., no private DMs, adult/carer welcome on camera/audio, moderated comments only).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when created.

SpecialInterestPathway.title: SpecialInterestPathway
SpecialInterestPathway.description: Private owner-only Ground Entry Kiosk Personal Dashboard record where each entrant types in their special interest and which job or trade role it could lead to.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the entrant who owns this personal dashboard pathway.

entrantHandle.description: Non-PII Workshop Handle chosen by the entrant.

specialInterest.description: The entrant's typed special interest, fascination, or deep focus topic.

potentialJobRole.description: The job, vocation, or trade role that the entrant feels this special interest could lead to.

tradeTrack.description: Matching Learn-a-Trade track in the Agarwood Treehouse Sanctuary.

comfortableNextStep.description: Optional calm, self-paced first step toward exploring this job pathway.

readinessStage.description: Self-paced readiness stage chosen by the entrant on their personal dashboard.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when created.

CraftedBottleListing.title: CraftedBottleListing
CraftedBottleListing.description: Maker-distilled, bottled, and custom-labelled special-interest product (such as Agarwood bark essential oil) placed on sale with readable labels in either the 0m Welcome Area, the 33m Canopy, or both.

makerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the maker who fashioned the tools, bottled, and labelled the batch.

makerName.description: Public non-PII workshop handle printed on the bottle label.

productTitle.description: Full product title (e.g. Sanctuary Agarwood Bark Essential Oil).

labelHeadline.description: High-contrast large-print headline printed on the bottle and 3D counter sign.

labelBatchNote.description: Botanical batch, bark origin, and volume note printed on the label.

barkOriginAndProcess.description: Craft pipeline note describing bark preparation, distillation tools, bottling, and labelling.

bottleSizeMl.description: Amber apothecary dropper bottle volume in millilitres (5, 10, 15, or 30).

saleVenue.description: Where the labelled bottles are placed on sale in the 3D Sanctuary.

pricePence.description: Welcome Area price in GBP pence (integer 300..50000, i.e. £3.00 to £500.00).

priceTokens.description: Canopy Trade Counter price in Treehouse Tokens (integer 1..50).

stockCount.description: Number of labelled bottles available on the counter (integer 0..50).

status.description: Sale listing lifecycle state (archived is terminal).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when bottled and listed.

CanopyPaypalItem.title: CanopyPayPalStoreItem
CanopyPaypalItem.description: A handcrafted maker work or workshop creation listed for PayPal checkout at the 33m Treetop Canopy Store.

sellerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the maker selling their work.

sellerName.description: Non-PII workshop handle of the maker.

title.description: Title of the handcrafted work or bottled batch.

tradeCategory.description: Canopy trade category of the work.

craftStory.description: Unhurried maker story describing how the work was crafted.

sellerBenchTag.description: Optional non-PII Canopy stall or PayPal reference tag.

priceCents.description: Unit price in GBP pence (300 to 250000, i.e. £3.00 to £2,500.00).

stockCount.description: Available quantity on the Canopy store counter.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when listed.

ShoeCharacterProfile.title: WelcomeAreaShoeCharacter
ShoeCharacterProfile.description: Stores a member's chosen 3D shoe or wellington boot character selected in the 0m Welcome Area.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

characterNickname.description: Friendly non-PII label for the member's footwear character.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when first chosen.

ChillPodState.title: ChillPodState
ChillPodState.description: Tracks strict one-per-person private Chill Pod occupancy and sensory controls on the 33m Treetop Mezzanine (zero PII).

podId.description: Identifier of the private Treetop Mezzanine Chill Pod.

podLabel.description: Display name of the private Treetop Mezzanine Chill Pod.

occupantId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the single occupant, or empty string when vacant.

occupantName.description: Non-PII workshop alias of the current pod occupant, or empty string when vacant.

occupancyStatus.description: Occupancy state enforcing strictly one person per pod.

fanEnabled.description: Whether the cooling overhead fan is switched on.

heaterEnabled.description: Whether the warm ceramic pod heater is switched on.

lightsOffCalm.description: Whether the pod interior light is turned off for low-glare sensory calm.

flotationEnabled.description: Whether warm-water sensory flotation is active in the pod berth.

quiltType.description: Selected weighted heavy quilt option (none, vegan bamboo/kapok plant-down, or natural duck feather).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when pod record was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when pod state was last updated.

JobCentreVacancy.title: JobCentreVacancy
JobCentreVacancy.description: Heritage Old-Style Job Centre Vacancy Index Card posted on the visible Ground Courtyard Job Centre Board.

referenceCode.description: Classic Job Centre stamped reference code (e.g. JC-101).

jobTitle.description: Clear job or trade role title on the index card.

tradeCategory.description: Trade discipline for the vacancy card.

locationZone.description: Treehouse station or zone where the role takes place.

cardSummary.description: Plain-language overview printed on the Job Centre card.

keySteps.description: Step-by-step duties printed on the Job Centre card.

collaborationMode.description: How fellow makers can collaborate on this job slip.

collaborationOpen.description: Whether other members can join this card as collaborators.

rewardTokens.description: Token credit awarded upon taking and practicing this role (integer 1..15).

creatorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member who pinned the vacancy card.

creatorName.description: Non-PII display alias of the card poster.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when pinned.

JobCentreCollaborator.title: JobCentreCollaborator
JobCentreCollaborator.description: Subcollection record of a member teaming up on an open Old-Style Job Centre Vacancy Card.

memberId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the collaborating member.

memberName.description: Non-PII display alias of the collaborator.

collabRole.description: Specific role claimed by the collaborator.

pledgeNote.description: Short note describing how the collaborator will contribute.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when joined.

UxBetaFeedback.title: UxBetaFeedback
UxBetaFeedback.description: Owner-or-Admin isolated UX beta test observation submitted via the Public Beta Testing Hub (zero PII).

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the UX tester.

focusArea.description: Feature area evaluated during UX testing.

easeScore.description: Ease & sensory comfort rating from 1 to 5.

workedWell.description: Notes on what felt intuitive or calming.

improvementIdea.description: Optional suggestions for improving clarity or accessibility.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when feedback was submitted.

DailyHabitTracker.title: DailyHabitTracker
DailyHabitTracker.description: Owner-isolated daily professional mastery habit tracker and tree-climbing energy points ledger for PassiveUserDashboard.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the member.

activeDate.description: Current YYYY-MM-DD local date corresponding to completedIdsToday.

energyPoints.description: Current spendable tree-climbing energy points balance (0..99999).

lifetimeEnergyEarned.description: Cumulative tree-climbing energy points earned across all sessions (0..999999).

totalMilestonesLogged.description: Cumulative count of professional mastery milestones logged (0..99999).

dailyStreak.description: Consecutive days with at least one professional mastery milestone logged (0..99999).

bestStreak.description: Highest consecutive daily habit streak achieved (0..99999).

completedIdsToday.description: Bounded allowlist (max 10) of habit IDs completed on activeDate.

customHabitLabels.description: Bounded list (max 5) of custom professional mastery habit labels (2..60 chars each).

lastMilestoneLabel.description: Short label of the most recently logged milestone.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the habit tracker was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the habit tracker was last updated.

BankOfTreetopLedger.title: BankOfTreetopLedger
BankOfTreetopLedger.description: Symbolic, educational Special-Interest Stock Savings Pot at the Bank of Treetop (NOT a real bank; zero real money or legal tender). Tracks saved Treetop Token units toward special-interest starter stock and unpaid volunteer Exchequer checks.

selectedBundleId.description: Selected special-interest starter stock bundle ID.

customInterestGoal.description: Optional custom special-interest stock goal description.

savedUnits.description: Symbolic Treetop Stock Pot units currently set aside.

lifetimeUnitsSaved.description: Cumulative symbolic Treetop Stock Pot units saved over time.

bundlesRequisitioned.description: Number of symbolic special-interest starter stock bundles unlocked.

exchequerChecksLogged.description: Count of unpaid volunteer Exchequer ledger tallies completed by this Jay's Job Club member.

disclaimerAccepted.description: Confirms understanding that Bank of Treetop is NOT a real bank and holds no real money.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the ledger was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the ledger was last updated.

/publicProfiles/{userId}.description: Stores public non-PII display handles keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/communityPosts/{postId}.description: Stores published and archived Ground Floor Job & Collab Board posts.

/canopyStudios/{userId}.description: Stores each player's personalized Canopy Trade Area, Secure Flooring, and placed 3D Lanterns/Furnishings.

/journalEntries/{entryId}.description: Stores private owner-only chronological Personal Journal entries.

/treeProgress/{userId}.description: Stores each member's Welcome Area check-in, Trying/Gathering/Treehouse Token balances, owned Canopy furnishings, and Daily Mastery Streak.

/toolsOfTrade/{toolId}.description: Stores Tools of the Trade for Canopy Show & Tell (private locker items and shared club Show & Tell items).

/storeListings/{listingId}.description: Stores player-to-player Canopy lantern and furnishing listings purchasable with Treehouse Tokens.

/serviceProviders/{providerId}.description: Stores autism-affirming & neurobiologically-aware Service Providers (Pre-Crisis Intervention Counsellors, Crisis Coaching Specialists, and Skills & Trade Trainers).

/artisanItems/{itemId}.description: Stores real handcrafted items listed in the Ground Floor Welcome Area Artisan Shop for PayPal checkout.

/privacyConsents/{userId}.description: Stores owner-only UK/EU GDPR Article 7(1) granular consent records keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores trusted workshop administrator UIDs authorized to approve Treetop Token entry applications.

/treetopApplications/{applicantId}.description: Stores Ground Sign-In Kiosk Special Interest Journey applications and Admin-approved Treetop Tokens required for entry.

/pgCertNotes/{noteId}.description: Stores PG Cert Autism and Mental Health student-in-training reflective study notes.

/canopyWorkshops/{workshopId}.description: Stores the 33m Treetop Canopy Rota of special interest training and learn-a-trade workshops.

/canopyWorkshops/{workshopId}/registrati.description: Stores Treetop Token holder workshop bookings and parent/carer or competent adult overflow approvals.

/canopyWorkshops/{workshopId}/overflowAc.description: Stores safeguarded Zoom/Facebook/Social Media overflow join details unlocked only after Treetop Token and adult approval.

/interestPathways/{pathwayId}.description: Stores private owner-only Ground Entry Kiosk Personal Dashboard entries mapping an entrant's special interest to a potential job or trade role.

/craftedBottles/{bottleId}.description: Stores custom-bottled and high-contrast labelled special-interest wares (such as Agarwood bark essential oil) placed on sale in the 0m Welcome Area, 33m Canopy, or both.

/canopyPaypalItems/{itemId}.description: Stores maker works listed for PayPal sale at the 33m Treetop Canopy Store.

/shoeCharacters/{userId}.description: Stores each member's chosen Welcome Area 3D shoe or wellington boot character.

/chillPodOccupancy/{podId}.description: Stores one-per-person private Chill Pod occupancy and sensory settings (fan, heater, lights off, flotation, vegan/natural quilt) on the 33m Treetop Mezzanine.

/jobCentreVacancies/{vacancyId}.description: Stores Old-Style Job Centre Vacancy Index Cards displayed on the visible Job Centre Board.

/jobCentreVacancies/{vacancyId}/collabor.description: Stores multi-user collaboration team-ups attached to an open Job Centre Vacancy Card.

/uxBetaFeedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores owner-and-admin isolated UX testing feedback entries collected during Public Beta.

/dailyHabitTrackers/{userId}.description: Stores owner-isolated daily professional mastery habit logs and tree-climbing energy points in PassiveUserDashboard.

/bankOfTreetopLedgers/{userId}.description: Stores owner-isolated symbolic Special-Interest Stock Savings Pots at the Bank of Treetop (not a real bank; zero real money).
